title: Praise the Savior, You Who Know Him
lyrics_original: Praise the Savior, you who know Him!
Who can tell how much we owe Him?
Gladly let us render to Him
All we are and have.
Jesus is the name that charms us;
He for conflict fits and arms us;
Nothing moves and nothing harms us
While we trust in Him.
Trust in Him, you saints, forever;
He is faithful, changing never;
Neither force nor guile can sever
Those He loves from Him.
Keep us, Lord, O keep us cleaving
To Thyself and still believing,
Till the hour of our receiving
Promised joys with Thee.
Then we shall be where we would be,
Then we shall be what we should be;
Things that are not now, nor could be,
Soon shall be our own.

bible_verses.english: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
Therefore I urge you, brothers and sisters, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your reasonable service.

For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the beauty of Your name and the unspeakable gift of Your salvation. I bring my heart before You today, offering all that I am as an act of joyful praise. When challenges arise, remind me that You arm me with strength and surround me with Your peace. Help me to trust You completely, anchored in Your unchanging faithfulness and love. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we reflect on the overwhelming depth of Christ’s love and sacrifice, our only natural response is heartfelt praise and total surrender. Jesus does not merely rescue us; He equips us for life's daily battles and anchors our hearts in His unshakeable peace. Nothing in all creation can separate us from His unfailing presence, and His unchanging character gives us confidence for every step ahead. Today, let us gladly offer Him all that we are, trusting the One who holds us fast forever.
